stage_controller.text:
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import hashlib, json, os, platform, shutil, subprocess, sys, time, zipfile

assert os.name == 'nt' and platform.node().split('.')[0].lower() == 'baiying'
def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest()
def read(path): return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(path, value):
    with Path(path).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(value, f, indent=2); f.write('\n')
def verify(path, expected, size=None):
    path = Path(path)
    assert path.is_file() and digest(path) == expected, str(path)
    if size is not None: assert path.stat().st_size == size, str(path)
    return path

input_path = Path(__file__).with_name('current-package-input-r1.json')
verify(input_path, '164d53b8af567d828873ea016a02711cb9f17e12b4bf5f843db62333347a743d')
config = read(input_path)
repo = Path(config['repo']); source = config['source_commit']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,timeout=10).strip() == source
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'status','--porcelain'],text=True,timeout=10).strip()
package_script = verify(repo/'scripts/package-runtime.ps1', config['package_script_sha256'])
http_script = verify(repo/'scripts/verify_baiying_q8192_http.py', config['http_script_sha256'])
base = Path(config['base_root'])
manifest_path = verify(base/'runtime-manifest.json', config['base_manifest_sha256'])
old = read(manifest_path)
assert old['dirty_tree'] is False and old['offload_arch'] == 'gfx1151'
for kind, component in config['components'].items():
    meta = read(verify(component['metadata']['path'], component['metadata']['sha256']))
    assert meta['repo_commit'] == component['commit'] and meta['dirty_tree'] is False
    if kind == 'server': assert meta['tests_run'] is True
for record in config['replacements'].values(): verify(record['path'], record['sha256'], record.get('bytes'))
environment_path = verify(config['source_environment']['path'], config['source_environment']['sha256'])
environment = environment_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
source_values = dict(line.split('=',1) for line in environment.splitlines() if line and not line.startswith('#'))
assert len(source_values) == 506

stage = repo/'build/runtime-current-package-r1'; stage.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
entries = {}
for old_entry in old['artifacts']:
    relative = old_entry['path']
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative.replace('\\','/'))
    assert not parts.is_absolute() and '..' not in parts.parts
    original = verify(base/relative, old_entry['sha256'], old_entry['bytes'])
    destination = stage/relative; destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record = config['replacements'].get(relative)
    shutil.copyfile(record['path'] if record else original, destination)
    entries[relative] = dict(path=relative, bytes=destination.stat().st_size, sha256=digest(destination))
for relative, record in config['replacements'].items():
    if relative in entries: continue
    destination = stage/relative; destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(record['path'],destination)
    entries[relative] = dict(path=relative, bytes=destination.stat().st_size, sha256=digest(destination))

path_mapping = {Path(record['path']): relative for relative, record in config['replacements'].items()}
path_mapping[Path(config['components']['fla']['artifact']['path']).parent] = 'fla'
rewrites = []; lines = []
for line in environment.splitlines():
    if not line or line.startswith('#'): lines.append(line); continue
    key, value = line.split('=',1)
    original_value = value
    candidate = Path(value)
    if value and candidate.is_absolute():
        relative = path_mapping.get(candidate)
        if relative is None:
            assert candidate.is_relative_to(base), (key,value)
            relative = candidate.relative_to(base).as_posix()
        assert (stage/relative).exists(), (key,relative)
        value = '${RUNTIME_DIR}/' + relative
        rewrites.append(dict(key=key, original=original_value, portable=value))
    lines.append(key+'='+value)
assert len(rewrites) == 33
profile = stage/'runtime.env'; profile.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
portable_values = dict(line.split('=',1) for line in lines if line and not line.startswith('#'))
assert portable_values.keys() == source_values.keys()
changed_keys = {r['key'] for r in rewrites}
assert all(portable_values[k] == source_values[k] for k in source_values if k not in changed_keys)
entries['runtime.env'] = dict(path='runtime.env',bytes=profile.stat().st_size,sha256=digest(profile))

manifest = {k:old[k] for k in ('schema_version','host','dirty_tree','offload_arch',
    'composable_kernel_tree_sha256','composable_kernel_source_file_count')}
manifest.update(repo_commit=source, component_commits={k:v['commit'] for k,v in config['components'].items()},
    source_component_builds=config['components'], artifacts=list(entries.values()),
    parent_manifest_sha256=digest(manifest_path), source_profile_sha256=digest(environment_path),
    source_product_evidence=config['source_product_evidence'], source_prefix_evidence=config['source_prefix_evidence'],
    purpose='Current correctness-passing stack in an unpublished portable package; performance and release gates remain open',
    profile_paths_portable=True, relocation_qualified=False, inference_qualified=False,
    performance_qualified=False, release_qualified=False, published=False,
    model_context_tokens=262144, maximum_prompt_tokens=263168, maximum_request_tokens=263680,
    attention_capacity_tokens=264736)
write(stage/'runtime-manifest.json',manifest)
args=['powershell.exe','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',str(package_script),
      '-RuntimeDir',str(stage),'-OutDir',str(repo/'build/current-package-archive-r1'),
      '-Version',config['version'],'-CkProviderRelativePath','ck-fmha/qrt_ck_fmha_sm121.dll']
started=time.monotonic()
packaged=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace',check=True,timeout=240)
package=json.loads(packaged.stdout)
archive=verify(package['archive'],package['sha256'],package['bytes'])
extract=repo/'build/relocated current package r1';extract.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None and len(z.infolist()) < 2000
    for entry in z.infolist():
        path=PurePosixPath(entry.filename)
        assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
    z.extractall(extract)
runtime=extract/archive.stem
release=read(runtime/'FILE-SHA256SUMS.json');assert release['source_commit']==source
for record in release['files']: verify(runtime/record['path'],record['sha256'],record['bytes'])
for record in entries.values(): verify(runtime/record['path'],record['sha256'],record['bytes'])
hidden=repo/'build/current-package-source-archived-r1';assert not hidden.exists();stage.rename(hidden)
assert not stage.exists()
http=config['reference_config'];http.update(server_commit=config['components']['server']['commit'],
    working_directory=str(repo),port=18151,execution_limits=dict(readiness_seconds=45,request_seconds=120,controller_seconds=360))
for key,relative in [('server','engine/qrt.exe'),('provider','whole-provider/qrt_qwen36_whole_provider.dll'),
                     ('env','runtime.env'),('runtime_manifest','runtime-manifest.json')]:
    path=runtime/relative;http['files'][key]=dict(path=str(path),sha256=digest(path))
oracle=repo/'contracts/hprefill_q8192_gb10_oracle.json'
verify(oracle,http['files']['oracle']['sha256']);http['files']['oracle']['path']=str(oracle)
http_path=repo/'build/current-package-http-config-r1.json';write(http_path,http)
report=dict(schema_version=1,host=platform.node(),source_commit=source,input_sha256=digest(input_path),
    controller_file=str(Path(__file__)),controller_sha256=digest(__file__),package_command=args,
    package_and_relocation_wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,package=package,package_stderr=packaged.stderr,
    parent_manifest_sha256=digest(manifest_path),stage_manifest_sha256=digest(runtime/'runtime-manifest.json'),
    archive_crc_pass=True,release_file_hashes_pass=True,runtime_file_hashes_pass=True,
    release_files=len(release['files']),runtime_artifacts=len(entries),portable_path_rewrites=rewrites,
    numeric_environment_options_unchanged=True,original_staging_directory_unavailable=True,
    archived_staging_directory=str(hidden),relocated_runtime_directory=str(runtime),
    relocated_profile_sha256=digest(runtime/'runtime.env'),release_file_manifest_sha256=digest(runtime/'FILE-SHA256SUMS.json'),
    config_sha256=digest(http_path),model_copied=False,inference_acceptance=False,performance_qualified=False,
    release_qualified=False,published=False)
write(repo/'build/current-package-archive-report-r1.json',report)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(http_script),'--config',str(http_path),'--out',str(repo/'build/current-package-cpu-preflight-r1')],check=True,timeout=90)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='current_package_staged_and_relocated',archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
    archive_sha256=digest(archive),release_files=len(release['files']),runtime_artifacts=len(entries),
    portable_paths=len(rewrites),original_staging_directory_unavailable=True,published=False)))
